list_gtest_tests: list all googletest tests by running the module with --gtest_list_tests argument
filter_passing_test: filter and run the FirstTest.subTestA test which passes successfully
filter_failing_test: filter and run the FirstTest.subTestB test which fails with exit code 1
filter_parameterized_test: filter and run a parameterized test like ParameterizedTest/0.subTest
validate_unexpected_args: validate that the module raises ValueError on unexpected arguments
